decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to utilize cards that can fill up the graveyard quickly and efficiently to enable the recursion of Arclight Phoenix. By including cards like Ledger Shredder, Opt, and Treasure Cruise, along with discard spells like Lightning Axe, the deck aims to constantly bring back Arclight Phoenix to pressure the opponent and close out the game quickly. The deck also includes counter spells like Spell Pierce to protect your key threats and disruptive spells like Brazen Borrower to control the game until you can overwhelm your opponent with flying threats.

This deck focuses on aggressive creatures and disruption spells to quickly overwhelm opponents. Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord helps to bring out powerful creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Archfiend of the Dross, while Preacher of the Schism can generate additional value. The deck also includes strong removal spells like Fatal Push and disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Duress to control the game. With a mix of efficient creatures, disruption, and ways to pump out extra damage, this Rakdos Aggro deck aims to close out games quickly and decisively.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly cast Arclight Phoenix by filling up the graveyard with instants and sorceries using cards like Lightning Axe, Treasure Cruise, and Fiery Impulse. Key cards like Ledger Shredder and Opt help dig for important pieces while also enabling the Phoenix's recursion ability. Picklock Prankster disrupts the opponent while profit's Eidetic Memory provides card advantage. The deck also includes some control elements like Spell Pierce and tempo plays like Brazen Borrower to maintain board presence. Overall, the strategy revolves around aggressive plays and leveraging the Phoenix's ability to return from the graveyard.

This deck aims to quickly fill up the graveyard with spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard multiple times in a single turn, overwhelming the opponent with aggressive flying creatures. The deck includes a mix of burn spells, card draw, and counter magic to support this strategy and maintain tempo. With efficient use of spells and resources, the goal is to land multiple Arclight Phoenixes in play and close out the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo utilizing Amalia Benavides Aguirre and various support cards to generate a large amount of life gain and creature tokens. The strategy involves searching for key pieces with cards like Chord of Calling and Collected Company, while also utilizing cards like Razorverge Thicket and Temple Garden to fix mana. Return to the Ranks and Aetherflux Reservoir are used as win conditions once the combo is fully active, with cards like Fauna Shaman and Selfless Savior providing additional support and protection for the combo pieces.

The deck focuses on combining the lifegain abilities of Amalia Benavides Aguirre, Prosperous Innkeeper, and Wildgrowth Walker with Aetherflux Reservoir to create a powerful life-gain combo. The deck also includes various creatures and spells to support the combo, such as Chord of Calling, Collected Company, and Return to the Ranks. The inclusion of Selfless Savior and Skyclave Apparition provides protection and removal options, while Thoughtseize helps disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to quickly increase its life total and then use Aetherflux Reservoir to deal lethal damage to the opponent.

The main idea of this deck is to use cheap spells and card draw effects to quickly fill the graveyard with Arclight Phoenixes, which can then be brought back for free to deal consistent damage and pressure the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Spell Pierce and Ashiok, Dream Render to slow down the opponent's game plan. The mana base is built to support the deck's low casting cost spells and to ensure smooth gameplay. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm and outpace the opponent with fast, aggressive plays.

The deck focuses on aggressive creature plays supported by disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. It utilizes tribal synergies with vampires and rogues, as well as generating additional value through card draw and recursion. The mana base is streamlined to support the deck's color requirements while also providing some utility lands for additional options. The key strategy is to apply pressure early on, disrupt the opponent's game plan, and close out the game quickly with a mix of evasive threats and efficient removal.

This deck focuses on controlling the opponent's board and hand through counterspells, removal spells, and card draw. It uses powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria to generate card advantage and dictate the pace of the game. Utilizing lands like Castle Ardenvale and Field of Ruin, along with spells like Supreme Verdict, the deck aims to maintain control of the battlefield. With a mix of counter magic, card draw, and removal, it aims to outvalue the opponent and win through incremental advantage.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize Lotus Field to generate a large amount of mana quickly in order to cast powerful spells, particularly combo pieces like Omniscience and Emergent Ultimatum. It also includes several cards that allow for card selection and digging through the deck for key pieces, as well as protection in the form of Strict Proctor. The deck aims to efficiently assemble its combo pieces to quickly overwhelm opponents and secure victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing Niv-Mizzet Reborn's ability to draw cards and gain card advantage with a wide range of multicolored spells. It aims to control the board with versatile removal spells like Vanishing Verse and Leyline Binding while ramping up with cards like Up the Beanstalk and Growth Spiral. The deck also includes powerful threats like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Klothys, God of Destiny to pressure the opponent. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's multicolored spells and ensure consistency in casting them.

This deck focuses on utilizing the combo potential of Amalia Benavides Aguirre along with cards like Wildgrowth Walker and Chord of Calling to quickly generate life and mana, eventually leading to a game-winning play with Aetherflux Reservoir or Finale of Devastation. Thoughtseize and Extraction Specialist add disruption to control the game, while Return to the Ranks provides recovery options. The deck is designed to have a strong early game presence with cards like Lunarch Veteran and Prosperous Innkeeper, while also having a potent late game finisher with the combo pieces.

The deck focuses on assembling a combo involving Amalia Benavides Aguirre, Return to the Ranks, and Aetherflux Reservoir to gain a large amount of life and then use Aetherflux Reservoir's ability to deal massive damage to the opponent. The deck includes cards to help generate mana, gain life, and protect key combo pieces. Fauna Shaman and Chord of Calling help tutor for the necessary pieces, while cards like Selfless Savior and Alseid of Life's Bounty provide protection for the combo. The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo and win the game in a single turn.

The deck focuses on aggressive play with a combination of low-cost creatures and removal spells to quickly dominate the board. It utilizes powerful cards like Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord and Archfiend of the Dross to put pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan with Thoughtseize and Duress. The deck aims to maintain an aggressive tempo by efficiently utilizing its mana base and creatures like Vein Ripper and Bloodtithe Harvester, supported by versatile lands like Mutavault and Cavern of Souls. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with early threats and finish the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly with cards like Elvish Mystic and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx to cast powerful green cards like Old-Growth Troll and Cavalier of Thorns. It also utilizes cards like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Nissa, Who Shakes the World to generate additional mana and card advantage. The deck's win condition revolves around creating a strong board presence with creatures and using Leyline of the Guildpact and Boseiju, Who Endures to protect and enhance its creatures, ultimately overwhelming opponents with a devotion to green strategy.

This deck focuses on quickly dealing damage to the opponent by utilizing efficient burn spells and aggressive creatures. It aims to empty the opponent's life total as fast as possible, often overwhelming them with a flurry of cheap, direct damage spells and impactful creatures. The deck's main strategy revolves around maintaining pressure on the opponent and finishing the game before they have a chance to stabilize. It capitalizes on its low mana curve to consistently apply pressure and close out games swiftly.
